basic_details.job_title: HPLNG Senior Engineer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: HPCL LNG Limited (HPLNG), a 100% subsidiary of Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Limited (HPCL), is inviting online applications for 1 Senior Engineer – Operations post in Salary Grade E1, pay scale 40000-140000, at its LNG terminal at Chhara, Gujarat. A full time regular engineering degree in Chemical, Mechanical, Electrical or Instrumentation Engineering with minimum 60% marks (50% for SC/ST/PwBD) and 2 years' operations experience is required, with a maximum age of 27 years. Applications are accepted on www.hplng.in from 18 November 2026 to 8 December 2026.

age_limit.details: The maximum age is 27 years as on 8 December 2026. | Category Relaxation SC and ST 5 years OBC-NC 3 years Domiciled in Jammu & Kashmir between 01.01.1980 and 31.12.1989 5 years Ex-servicemen & Commissioned Officers (including ECOs/SSCOs) Length of military service increased by three years, subject to other conditions prescribed by Govt. of India | The age condition for Unreserved category applies to EWS candidates. The notice lists these PwBD categories as suitable for the post: HH, OA, OL, CP, Dw, AAV, SLD, MI, MD (any of the combinations). Reservation of posts for SC, ST, OBC-NC and EWS is as per Government Directives; the notice prints no category-wise break-up of the single vacancy. Candidates should check the official notification for full eligibility details.

qualification.details: Post Essential Qualification Senior Engineer – Operations Full time regular engineering degree in Chemical/Mechanical/Electrical/Instrumentation Engineering from AICTE approved / UGC recognized University/Deemed University, with minimum 60% marks for UR/OBC-NC/EWS and 50% for SC/ST/PwBD. | Experience: 02 years' experience in operations, of which 01 year in DCS operations in Large Hydrocarbons Sector or in process plant/Fertilizer plant is mandatory. Experience as Panel or DCS Operator is essential, with good knowledge of DCS/PLC operations, safety standard codes and statutory requirements. Preferred: experience in cryogenic facilities/LNG operations. Preference is also given to candidates with relevant experience. "Large Hydrocarbon Sector" means LNG Terminal/Petro-Chemical Plants/Refineries/LPG Import Terminals/Gas Processing Plants. All work experience is counted only after the qualifying degree or certification. Candidates who completed a BE/BTech degree after a 3 years diploma are also eligible, provided the BE/BTech is in one of the listed disciplines. Where CGPA/OGPA or a letter grade is awarded, the equivalent percentage must be entered in the application form, and a certificate from the University/Institute to this effect is required at the time of interview shortlisting.

how_to_apply: Apply online only on www.hplng.in after reading the detailed advertisement. No other mode of application is accepted.
Applications are accepted from 18 November 2026 and the last date of online application is 8 December 2026.
Use an email id and mobile number that stay valid for at least one year. The email id must be created in the candidate's own name.
Upload only a "Single PDF File". Zip, rar or any other format is not accepted.
Check the details before submitting: all details in the submitted form are treated as final, and a change of category is not considered.
Updated resume and Personal Information Form.
All educational qualification certificates (10th, 12th, Graduation, Post-Graduation and Certification).
All work experience letters, including the appointment letter of the current employer if any.

Applications without these supporting documents may be rejected as incomplete. Queries can be emailed to careers@hplng,in (as printed in the notice), with the subject line "Position Name- Application Number".
important_instructions: Reservation claimants must produce a certificate in the prescribed proforma, downloadable from the HPLNG website. OBC-NC certificates must be not older than 6 months as on the cut-off date and must state that the candidate does not belong to the creamy layer. OBC candidates in the "Creamy Layer" must indicate their category as Unreserved (UR). OBC-NC candidates give a self-undertaking at the personal interview if called. EWS candidates submit the Income and Asset Certificate, valid for financial year 2025-26, at the interview. Without it they are not allowed to appear for interview. Candidates in Government Departments/PSUs/Autonomous Bodies must produce a No Objection Certificate in original hard copy at the personal interview, or they will not be allowed to appear for the selection process. If an SC/ST/OBC-NC certificate is in a language other than English/Hindi, a self-certified translated copy in English or Hindi is required. Submit only one application. If several are submitted for the same position, the latest is final and older ones are rejected. Candidates must hold all degree certificates and mark sheets at the time of application. Any mismatch with the application form leads to disqualification at any stage. The number of vacancies is provisional, and HPLNG reserves the right not to fill any or all posts. Canvassing in any form leads to cancellation of candidature. Any dispute falls under the court of jurisdiction at Mumbai.

content_sections.heading: About HPLNG
content_sections.text: HPCL LNG Limited has its Registered Office at Ahmedabad, Gujarat and its Corporate Office at Mumbai, Maharashtra. It operates a 5 MMTPA LNG Regasification Terminal for receipt, unloading, storage and regasification of LNG and supply of regasified LNG to the gas grid. The terminal is at Village Chhara, Taluka Kodinar, District Gir-Somnath, Gujarat, within the boundary of Chhara Port, and commercial operations began on 1 February 2025.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only Indian Nationals are eligible. Age, experience and qualification are all reckoned as on 8 December 2026. Experience: 02 years' experience in operations, of which 01 year in DCS operations in Large Hydrocarbons Sector or in process plant/Fertilizer plant is mandatory. Experience as Panel or DCS Operator is essential, with good knowledge of DCS/PLC operations, safety standard codes and statutory requirements. Preferred: experience in cryogenic facilities/LNG operations. Preference is also given to candidates with relevant experience. "Large Hydrocarbon Sector" means LNG Terminal/Petro-Chemical Plants/Refineries/LPG Import Terminals/Gas Processing Plants. All work experience is counted only after the qualifying degree or certification. Candidates who completed a BE/BTech degree after a 3 years diploma are also eligible, provided the BE/BTech is in one of the listed disciplines. Where CGPA/OGPA or a letter grade is awarded, the equivalent percentage must be entered in the application form, and a certificate from the University/Institute to this effect is required at the time of interview shortlisting. The maximum age is 27 years as on 8 December 2026. The age condition for Unreserved category applies to EWS candidates. The notice lists these PwBD categories as suitable for the post: HH, OA, OL, CP, Dw, AAV, SLD, MI, MD (any of the combinations). Reservation of posts for SC, ST, OBC-NC and EWS is as per Government Directives; the notice prints no category-wise break-up of the single vacancy. Candidates should check the official notification for full eligibility details.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The candidate will be inducted at the starting of the pay scale. The CTC is calculated at the minimum base level of the pay grade and includes Basic Pay, Dearness Allowance, HRA, Cafeteria Allowance and Retirement Benefits including NPS. No HRA is payable on opting for company provided accommodation. Retirement benefits are admissible on separation/retirement as per the Company's policy prevailing at that time. Over and above the CTC, telephone bill reimbursement, laptop purchase reimbursement on joining, laptop internet connectivity charges, a group family floater medical policy for employees and dependent family members, and a GPAI policy apply as per prevailing policies. Selected officers are on probation for 1 year from the date of joining and are then considered for confirmation as per company policy. A retention amount of Rs. 5,000/- per month is deducted from total emoluments for the first six months of probation. It is refunded without interest only after confirmation and is forfeited if the employee leaves or is terminated before confirmation. All postings are at the Chhara terminal, work may involve shift duties, and postings are transferable within HPCL LNG Limited as per business requirement.

content_sections.heading: HPLNG Senior Engineer – Operations Job Description
content_sections.text: Ensuring safe and efficient operation of LNG Storage & LNG Regasification in accordance with agreed safety and operational objectives and procedures. Participating in the testing of automatic shutdown/protection systems. Keeping maintenance, operation and training information and changes to procedures and equipment up-to-date and accurately recorded. Preparing and submitting reports on a Daily/Weekly/Monthly/Quarterly basis. Training a competent workforce using prepared, up-to-date training programs. Participating in handling emergencies as per the Emergency Response & Disaster management Plan. Planning daily production operation and monitoring its execution for timely achievement of targets. Planning and executing initiatives for productivity/quality improvement and cost reengineering. Guiding and motivating subordinates/operators through on the job guidance and training. Overseeing quality assurance and business excellence initiatives, and working closely with Technicians to solve problems with machinery. Conducting safety training and ensuring adherence to safety and environment norms. Maintaining daily logs and reports, and reporting, resolving and recording daily issues relating to delays, bottlenecks, manpower skills, education and experience. Good understanding of cryogenic liquid handling and its effect on humans and surroundings; familiarity with PSM elements like MOC, HAZOP, ERDMP and Permit to work. Working in shifts based on plant requirements and taking additional responsibilities as and when assigned.

content_sections.text: Updated resume and Personal Information Form. All educational qualification certificates (10th, 12th, Graduation, Post-Graduation and Certification). All work experience letters, including the appointment letter of the current employer if any. Applications without these supporting documents may be rejected as incomplete. Queries can be emailed to careers@hplng,in (as printed in the notice), with the subject line "Position Name- Application Number".

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates meeting all eligibility criteria on scrutiny of the application, uploaded documents and the category-wise and discipline-wise merit list are considered for further selection. If applications are large, HPLNG may adopt shortlisting criteria to restrict the number called. Interview: depending on the number of eligible candidates, a single stage or multiple stage interview. Interview call letters, if any, are not sent in hard copy. Merit list: a category-wise merit list is drawn for candidates who qualify in all selection parameters, with minimum qualifying marks of 60% for UR/OBC-NC/EWS and 50% for SC/ST. Medical: shortlisted candidates undergo the Pre-Employment Medical Examination at HPLNG nominated hospitals. This does not mean final selection. A discipline-wise and category-wise final merit list is drawn for medically fit candidates. Travel: 3rd AC rail fare by the shortest route is reimbursed to outstation interview candidates travelling at least 30 km, through the Travel Allowance Form on the HPLNG website with tickets and travel proof. This is not applicable to candidates already in Central/State Government Services/PSUs.
